name: tubealfred-youtube
description: Fetch YouTube video, channel, transcript, comments, replies, search, and playlist data from inside Claude Desktop. Uses the TubeAlfred API.
long_description:
TubeAlfred exposes 12 read-only YouTube research tools through one hosted MCP server: fetch_youtube_video, fetch_youtube_transcript, fetch_youtube_comments, fetch_youtube_comments_page, fetch_youtube_comment_replies, fetch_youtube_comment_replies_page, fetch_youtube_channel, fetch_youtube_channel_videos, search_youtube, suggest_youtube_searches, fetch_youtube_playlist, and resolve_youtube_url. Install this extension, paste your API key, and the tools appear in Claude Desktop's tool list.

Credits: 1 per call for most endpoints. Comment endpoints meter per item: 1 credit per 5 comments, 100-comment minimum per call.

tubealfred_api_key.title: TubeAlfred API key
tubealfred_api_key.description: Create one at https://tubealfred.com/app/api-keys. Live keys start with ta_live_, test keys with ta_test_.
